levels.goal: Parse valid JSON and refuse malformed input without guessing.
Identify fields, values, unknowns and source references.
Check required fields, types, enums and unsupported fields.
Detect contradictions such as VERIFIED without evidence.
Separate data, proposal, approval and execution authority.
Repair malformed or contradictory packets without changing intended meaning.
Translate prose to JSON and back without claim, uncertainty or lineage loss.
Propose versioned schema changes with backward-readable history.

promotion_rule: Each level requires human-reviewed episodes, unseen cases, zero critical authority seams, and a preserved repair receipt.
truth_boundary: Valid JSON is not necessarily valid truth.
